commands.abstract: Describe the commands, their flags, their --json data and the error codes.
commands.name: silta schema

commands.abstract: List workspaces; ask in chat before editing configuration.
commands.name: silta ws ls

commands.abstract: Set the default workspace outside registered repositories.
commands.name: silta ws use

commands.name: silta ws show

commands.name: silta init

commands.abstract: Fetch a repo, or all registered repos in the workspace, without prompting.
commands.name: silta repo fetch

commands.abstract: Add a proposal; --start claims work requested by the human.
commands.name: silta task add

commands.abstract: List workspace tasks, including your own proposals.
commands.name: silta task ls

commands.abstract: Read task bodies, claim, handoff and unresolved discussion.
commands.name: silta task show

commands.abstract: Claim a todo task for this exact actor and session.
commands.name: silta task start

commands.abstract: Submit doing work for review and release its claim.
commands.name: silta task submit

commands.abstract: Complete a task with its result and optional app commit.
commands.name: silta task done

commands.abstract: Drop an open task and record why.
commands.name: silta task drop

commands.name: silta task from-plan

commands.abstract: Keep a task visible regardless of its closed age.
commands.name: silta task keep

commands.abstract: Link a task to a reference in this workspace or an external URL.
commands.name: silta task link

commands.name: silta task promote

commands.abstract: Record blockers; Silta sends nothing.
commands.name: silta task block

commands.abstract: Return a blocked batch to todo; an open blocker needs the human's go-ahead.
commands.name: silta task unblock

commands.abstract: Read a committed file, optionally selecting lines.
commands.name: silta code show

commands.abstract: Search committed text, returning app-relative paths and line numbers.
commands.name: silta code grep

commands.abstract: List commit SHA and subject at the selected ref.
commands.name: silta code log

commands.abstract: List immediate committed names in an app-relative directory.
commands.name: silta code ls

commands.abstract: Resolve the workspace, repository and app for a local path.
commands.name: silta where

commands.abstract: Diagnose database, git and data across all workspaces without repairs.
commands.name: silta doctor

commands.abstract: Post task discussion; a claimer's handoff releases its claim.
commands.name: silta comment

commands.abstract: Resolve discussion threads atomically.
commands.name: silta comment resolve

commands.abstract: Reopen discussion threads atomically.
commands.name: silta comment reopen

commands.abstract: Soft-delete your own post, retaining its ref and thread.
commands.name: silta comment delete

commands.abstract: Accept an answer as the asker or current claimer and resolve the thread.
commands.name: silta comment accept

commands.abstract: Read budgeted local context for the current task.
commands.name: silta brief

commands.abstract: Read current local attention without marking it read.
commands.name: silta inbox

commands.abstract: Read the agent manual, or one topic.
commands.name: silta guide

commands.abstract: Preview owned harness edits; confirm with --apply <token>.
commands.name: silta agents install

commands.abstract: Preview removal of selected, unedited Silta ownership.
commands.name: silta agents uninstall

commands.abstract: Read fresh own claims needing handoff across all workspaces.
commands.name: silta session check

commands.abstract: Print a one-line status: workspace, app, inbox count and your claimed tasks.
commands.name: silta status

commands.abstract: Write one workspace as a deterministic text tree for backup and diff.
commands.name: silta export

commands.abstract: Replace a workspace from an export tree (human-only, except --dry-run).
commands.name: silta restore

commands.abstract: Create a whole-database SQLite snapshot.
commands.name: silta backup
